title: Ghost Stories
summary: The opening establishes the Ghost legend and shows the Federation hijacking the U.S. ODIN orbital weapon. ODIN is turned on American cities before the station is destroyed. Ten years later, Logan and Hesh Walker serve along the ruined U.S. frontier.
key_events: kinetic strikes on the United States
ten-year jump to the Federation War

title: Brave New World
summary: Logan, Hesh and Riley return from the Liberty Wall after a Federation incursion. At Fort Santa Monica they receive new orders from Elias Walker, who is more closely connected to the Ghosts than his sons initially realize.
key_events: Elias issues mission beyond the Wall

title: No Man's Land
summary: Logan, Hesh and Riley cross the devastated zone beyond the Wall. They discover Federation activity around an ODIN crash site, learn that Gabriel Rorke is involved, and link up with Ghost operators Merrick and Keegan.

title: Struck Down
summary: The team assaults a Federation-held stadium to recover captured Ghost Alex 'Ajax' Johnson. Ajax is found mortally wounded, confirming that Rorke is systematically hunting the Ghosts.

title: Homecoming
locations: Fort Santa Monica, Los Angeles, California
summary: Federation forces launch a major offensive against Fort Santa Monica. Logan and Hesh help defend the position while the war closes in on the last major U.S. defensive line in the region.
key_events: Walker brothers drawn deeper into Ghost operations

title: Legends Never Die
summary: A flashback shows the Ghosts under Gabriel Rorke during Operation Return to Sender. They kill Federation leader Diego Almagro, but catastrophic flooding forces Elias to leave Rorke behind to save the rest of the team. Rorke is later captured and turned by the Federation.

title: Federation Day
summary: The Ghosts infiltrate a Caracas skyscraper during Federation Day and interrogate Victor Ramos for information on Rorke's location. The mission exposes how deeply Rorke has become embedded in Federation operations.

title: Birds of Prey
locations: Campeche oil fields, Gulf of Mexico
summary: An Apache assault supports the Ghosts as they strike the oil fields where Rorke is hiding. The team captures him and begins transporting him back toward U.S. territory.

title: The Hunted
summary: Federation forces destroy the Ghosts' transport aircraft and free Rorke. Logan is separated from the others in the Yucatán jungle and must survive pursuit before regrouping.

title: Clockwork
summary: Disguised in Federation uniforms, the Ghosts infiltrate a remote research base and steal computer data. The intelligence points toward larger Federation plans against the United States.

title: Atlas Falls
locations: Atlas oil platform, Drake Passage / Antarctica
summary: The Ghosts assault a key Federation oil platform to create a strategic distraction and weaken naval operations. The platform is destroyed as part of the broader plan to open a path toward Federation assets.

title: Into the Deep
locations: Off the coast of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
summary: Logan and Keegan conduct an underwater operation against a Federation vessel equipped with a devastating sonar weapon. Logan uses a Proteus missile to destroy the ship.

title: End of the Line
locations: Federation weapons factory, Rio de Janeiro region, Brazil
summary: The Ghosts infiltrate a Federation weapons facility and discover that the Federation is developing its own orbital kinetic bombardment system, later identified as LOKI.

title: Sin City
summary: Rorke captures the Ghosts at their Las Vegas safehouse. Elias Walker is executed in front of his sons, turning the conflict with Rorke into a deeply personal vendetta.

title: All or Nothing
summary: The United States commits the USS Liberator in a final push to stop the Federation's orbital weapon. Logan and Hesh defend the carrier during a massive naval and air battle.

title: Severed Ties
summary: U.S. ground forces assault the Federation's satellite-control infrastructure in Chile. Destroying the ground array makes it possible for an American space team to seize LOKI.

title: Loki
summary: A U.S. space team boards and commandeers the Federation's LOKI station. The captured orbital weapon is then turned against Federation military targets on the ground.
key_events: orbital strikes redirected against Federation targets

title: The Ghost Killer
locations: Federation supply train, Atacama Desert, Chile
summary: Logan and Hesh board Rorke's train to avenge Elias. They apparently kill him after calling a LOKI strike on the train, but Rorke survives, ambushes the brothers on shore and drags Logan away, leaving the campaign unresolved.
